column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4 Sodom slum confrontation
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: So, as I thought, you have...
decided to fight Gomorrah alongside us after all!!
No. We have decided that we cannot agree with your way of thinking!!
Before that, let me ask you something:
Is it true that this city forces those who can no longer work into the slums!?
So Gomorrah's people have been putting ideas in your heads!!
It is true that there is a slum, but...
They really are bullying the $$弱者$$!
What did you say!? Are you criticizing the way our city does things!?
It would be one thing if, from the outset, they could not work because there were no jobs,
but surely we cannot support lazy people who refuse to work!?
Those people must have let Gomorrah's lot talk them around!!
If that is how it is, we will take them all out by force!!
